segments.sn38.11:1.6: “Atthi panāvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāyā”ti?
segments.sn38.11:1.7: “Atthi kho, āvuso, maggo atthi paṭipadā, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāyā”ti.
segments.sn38.11:1.8: “Katamo panāvuso, maggo katamā paṭipadā, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāyā”ti?
segments.sn38.11:1.9: “Ayameva kho, āvuso, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāya, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn38.11:1.10: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn38.11:1.11: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāyā”ti.
segments.sn38.11:1.12: “Bhaddako, āvuso, maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā, etesaṃ oghānaṃ pahānāya.

lines: 316-328. Te loke sugatāti te rāgādayo pahāya gatattā suṭṭhu gatāti sugatā.

Yasmā dukkhavedanāvinimuttasaṅkhatadhamme sukhavedanāya ca yathā idha saṅkhāradukkhatā vipariṇāmadukkhatāti dukkhapariyāyo niruppateva, tasmā dukkhasabhāvo dhammo ekena dukkhasaddena visesetvā vutto “dukkhadukkhatā”ti.
